XI.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=11|verse=37}} And vvhen he vvas {{ls}}peaking, a certaine Phari{{ls}}ee de{{ls}}ired him that he vvould dine vvith him. and he going in {{ls}}ate dovvne to eate. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=38}} And the Phari{{ls}}ee began to thinke vvithin him {{ls}}elf and to {{ls}}ay, VVhy he vvas not vva{{ls}}hed before dinner. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=39}} And our Lord {{ls}}aid to him, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 23, 25.''}}* Novv you Phari{{ls}}ees doe make cleane that on the out {{ls}}ide of the cuppe and of the platter: but that of yours vvhich is vvithin, is ful of rapine and iniquitie. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=40}} Fooles, did not he that made that on the out{{ls}}ide, make that al{{ls}}o that is on the in{{ls}}ide? {{verse|chapter=11|verse=41}} But yet c {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''Quod {{ls}}upere{{ls}}t, {{lang|grc|τὰ ἐνόντα}}'',}}∷ that that remaineth, {{sup|‖}} giue almes, & behold al things are cleane vnto you. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=42}} But vvo to you Phari{{ls}}ees, becau{{ls}}e you tithe minte and revve and euery herbe: and pa{{ls}}{{ls}}e ouer iudgement and the charitie of God. but the{{ls}}e things you ought to haue done, and not to omit tho{{ls}}e. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=43}} Wo to you Phari{{ls}}ees, becau{{ls}}e you loue the fir{{ls}}t chaires in the {{ls}}ynagogs, and {{ls}}alutations in the market-place. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=44}} Wo to you, becau{{ls}}e you are as monuments that appeare not, and men vvalking ouer, are not vvare.

{{verse|chapter=11|verse=45}} And one of the Lavvyers an{{ls}}vvering {{ls}}aith to him, Mai{{ls}}ter, in {{ls}}aying the{{ls}}e things, thou {{ls}}peake{{ls}}t to our reproche al{{ls}}o. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=46}} But he {{ls}}aid, {{sup|‖}} Vvo to you Lavvyers al{{ls}}o: becau{{ls}}e you lode men vvith burdens which they can not beare, and your {{ls}}elues touch not the packes vvith one of your fingers. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=47}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Go{{ls}}pel for many Martyrs.}}∷ Wo to you that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Not the building of the Prophets monuments is condemned, but their imitation of their fathers that {{ls}}lew the Prophets. Ambro{{ls}}.}}∷ build the monumēts of the Prophets: and your fathers did kil them. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=48}} Surely you doe te{{ls}}tifie that you con{{ls}}ent to the vvorkes of your fathers: becau{{ls}}e they in deede did kil them, and you build their {{ls}}epulchres. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=49}} For this cau{{ls}}e the wi{{ls}}edom al{{ls}}o of God {{ls}}aid, I vvil {{ls}}end to them Prophets and Apo{{ls}}tles, and of them they vvil kil and per{{ls}}ecute. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=50}} that the bloud of al the Prophets that vvas {{ls}}hed from the making of the vvorld, may be required of this generation, {{verse|chapter=11|verse=51}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 4, 8.''}}* from the bloud of Abel vnto the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''2. Par. 24, 22.''}}* bloud of Zacharie that vvas {{ls}}laine betvvene the altar and the temple. Yea I {{ls}}ay to you, it {{ls}}hal be required of this generation.⊣ {{verse|chapter=11|verse=52}} Vvo to you Lavvyers, becau{{ls}}e you haue taken avvay the key of knovvledge: your {{ls}}elues haue not entred, and tho{{ls}}e that did enter you haue prohibited. {{verse|chapter=11|verse=53}} And vvhen he {{ls}}aid the{{ls}}e things to them, the Phari{{ls}}ees and the Lavvyers began vehemently to vrge him, and to {{ls}}toppe his mouth about many things, {{verse|chapter=11|verse=54}} lying in waite for him, & {{ls}}eeking to catch {{ls}}ome thing of his mouth, that they might accu{{ls}}e him.
